Each lesson is a set of slides with live R code. You do not need R or RStudio installed to try the examples. Edit any code block and press **Run Code** to see the results. That said, I recommend you to install R and RStudio and follow the material on your computer.

## Lessons

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| eval: true
#| results: asis
#| warning: false

# Builds the lesson table automatically from every Day*.qmd in this folder.
# Add a new lesson file, render, and it appears here. Nothing to edit below.

files <- sort(list.files(pattern = "^Day.*\\.qmd$"))

get_field <- function(lines, key) {
  fences <- which(trimws(lines) == "---")
  hdr <- if (length(fences) >= 2) lines[1:fences[2]] else lines
  hit <- grep(paste0("^", key, ":"), hdr, value = TRUE)
  if (length(hit) == 0) return(NA_character_)
  trimws(gsub('^"|"$', "", sub(paste0("^", key, ":\\s*"), "", hit[1])))
}

if (length(files) == 0) {
  cat("_No lessons published yet._\n")
} else {
  for (f in files) {
    l     <- readLines(f, warn = FALSE)
    sub_t <- get_field(l, "subtitle")
    topic <- if (!is.na(sub_t)) sub_t else tools::file_path_sans_ext(f)
    cat(sprintf("| [%s](%s) \n", topic, sub("\\.qmd$", ".html", f)))
  }
  }
```

::: callout-tip
